task: Implement two_sum(nums, target): return indices of the two numbers adding to target; raise/handle not-found idiomatically per language.
note: Subject's native code style (no comments by policy). Auditors assess correctness, idiomaticity, error handling.

solutions.code:
-- variant: find value pairs (a.value1, a.value2) summing to :target
SELECT a.id, b.id
FROM nums a
JOIN nums b
  ON b.id > a.id
 AND a.value + b.value = :target;
